simple.summary: דִּבְלַיִם (Diblayim) means Diblajim , a symbolic name First listed occurrence: Hos 1 3.

definitions.full: H1691. Diblayim [ דִּבְלַ֫יִם ] proper name, masculine father of Gomer wife of Hosea דִּבְלָ֑יִם Hosea 1:3 .
definitions.rootNote: dual from the masculine of 1690 ; two cakes;
